component.name: S-Shot Wayland
component.summary: Lightweight Native Wayland Screenshot and Annotation Tool

description.p: S-Shot Wayland is a lightweight, low-resource screenshot and image annotation application rewritten specifically for Linux Wayland compositors (GNOME, KDE Plasma, Cinnamon Wayland, Hyprland, Sway, COSMIC).

ul.li: Native Wayland capture via XDG Desktop Portal and wlr-screencopy
Precision screen color picker via Portal
Multi-tab editor with rich drawing tools (Pen, Highlighter, Arrow, Shapes)
Sequential badge counter with stepper (+/-) and reset
Privacy blur and pixelation with adjustable strength levels
Directional canvas resizing (expansion and reduction) with white canvas fill
White background fill on area selection deletion
Clean borderless text annotations with full inline editing
Direct pasting of clipboard images onto active canvas
System tray integration and minimal idle memory footprint

description.p: Initial release of S-Shot Wayland (v1.32): complete native Wayland rewrite with low memory usage, XDG Desktop Portal capture, screen color picker, directional canvas resizing, borderless text editing, and multi-layer clipboard pasting.
